sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE VINAY SARAF  ON THE 2 nd OF JUNE, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 13701 of 2025  AAKASH  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS

Appearance:
 Shri Sanjay Kumar Sharma, counsel for the applicant.
Shri Jayesh Yadav, P.L. for State.

ORDER This is first bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail filed by the applicant in connection with Crime No.23/2024 (dated : not mentioned), registered at Police Station - Sailana, District - Ratlam for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

In the statement of prosecutrix recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C.
she has not levelled any allegation against the applicant.
He is in jail since 3.02.2025 and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
In such circumstances, the applicant may be released on bail.

3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for grant of bail on the ground that DNA report and the FSL report are positive NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:13941 2 MCRC-13701-2025 and statement of prosecutrix has not been recorded during trial till today.

4. Taking into consideration that prosecutrix has not levelled any allegation against the applicant in her statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. and the custody period, however without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the view that the present applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

5. It is directed that applicant Aakash shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
The applicant shall appear before the trial Court on all the dates fixed by the trial Court without any default and shall also comply with provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
